svg.title: What Evernote's Encrypt Selected Text can and cannot lock
svg.desc: Evernote's Encrypt Selected Text can encrypt text including its formatting and header sizes, dividers, inline checkboxes and links. It cannot encrypt files and images, lists and checklists, tables, web clips, calendar events or tasks. An entire note or notebook cannot be encrypted, and the note title and everything outside the encrypted block stay readable.
svg.text: What Encrypt Selected Text can lock
From Evernote's help article "Encrypt text in a note", checked 17 October 2026. Mac, Windows and Evernote Web.
Text, with formatting and header sizes
Evernote never receives it and can't recover it.
Nor a whole note or notebook.
These stay readable to the service.
The note's title and everything outside the encrypted block stay readable to the service.
